verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a broad GraphQL Admin API that "extend[s] and enhance[s] the Shopify admin," plus a Storefront API covering browse-to-checkout and GraphiQL for running mutations, but nothing claims full UI–API parity. Community reports name specific gaps: refunds of app charges cannot be done via the API, and some API areas are gated by account tier, which forces CSV workarounds. Missing for 10: an explicit documented parity claim or coverage map between admin UI and API, independent confirmation that admin features such as refunds are reachable programmatically, and API access that is not gated by plan.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Admin API lets you build apps and integrations that extend and enhance the Shopify admin.
